static string DescribeRoundRobin()
    {
        return "Performs a round-robin cycle on a Queue<string> by calling "
             + "Dequeue to remove the front element in O(1) amortized time, "
             + "appending it to the log list, then re-inserting it at the back "
             + "with Enqueue in O(1) amortized time. The loop runs for at most "
             + "'rounds' iterations, stopping early if the queue becomes empty. "
             + "Queue<string> uses a circular internal array buffer that is "
             + "resized when full. The queue size remains unchanged after the "
             + "method returns because each Dequeue is paired with an Enqueue. "
             + "Dequeue throws InvalidOperationException on an empty queue but "
             + "the Count guard prevents this.";
    }
